actions.label: Shopping list
actions.description: See what's on your shopping list.
actions.agent: Read the person's shopping list: each item's id, name, quantity, unit and whether it is checked.

actions.label: Add to list
actions.description: Add an item to your shopping list.
actions.agent: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity and unit out when they gave none.

name.label: Item
name.description: What to buy, as the person said it, such as "oat milk".

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: The unit of the quantity, such as g, cups or cartons.

actions.label: Bought
actions.description: Tick an item off your shopping list, or untick it.
actions.agent: Mark one item on the person's shopping list as bought (checked) or not bought. Take the id from get_shopping_list.

checked.label: Bought
checked.description: true when the item is bought, false to put it back.

actions.label: Search recipes
actions.description: Find a recipe in your kitchen.
actions.agent: Search the person's recipes by title. Returns each match's id and title.

actions.label: Add ingredients to list
actions.description: Put a recipe's ingredients on your shopping list.
actions.agent: Add every ingredient of one recipe to the person's shopping list. Take the recipe's id from search_recipes.

actions.label: Place order
actions.description: Order everything on your list and pay for it.
actions.agent: Order the shopping list's items for delivery and pay for them.

personOnly.reason: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can.
personOnly.how: with Place order on the shopping list
